description: This Java source file defines security configuration for a Spring Boot application. It uses Spring Security 6 features to set up HTTP security rules, including disabling CSRF, allowing unauthenticated access to API documentation and H2 console endpoints, enabling frame options for H2, and setting up HTTP Basic authentication for protected endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configures security settings for the application, including endpoint access rules and security headers.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain with specific security settings: disables CSRF, allows open access to Swagger and H2 console endpoints, enforces authentication elsewhere, and enables HTTP Basic authentication.
